modelIndicator.construction: Actual deltoid facet199 at Y1.33814 is a superficial registration of the native pectoralis insertion facet45 Y1.33836. Separate addressed pectoral observation defines axial level, not deltoid identity.
limitations: No source axillary skin crease; static model correspondence to pectoral insertion plane, not a detected fold.

modelIndicator.construction: Observed distal tendon facet351 near distal humeral articulation. Authored cubital indicator at joint plane and 4mm lateral correspondence; no source skin crease or 90-degree flexion produced.
limitations: Elbow is extended; flexible crease/depression transferred as static structural indicator only.
